newsitem.title: USA: ICB Shipping unit files for IPO.
newsitem.headline: ICB Shipping unit files for IPO.

text.p: Knightsbridge Tankers Ltd filed Monday with the Securities and Exchange Commission for the initial public offering of up to 15 million common shares.
Knightsbridge, currently a unit of ICB Shipping BF of Sweden, said that of the total, 12 million shares will be offered in the U.S. and 3.0 million to other countries in an international offering.
The company said it estimates the initial offering price at $20.00 a share.

Net proceeds from the offering, together with credit facility advances of about $184 million and payments under a finance lease arrangment, will be used by units of Knightsbridge to buy five double-hull very large crude carriers (VLCCs) at $92 million a vessel.

Part of the proceeds will also be used to collateralize obligations under the financing arrangements and to pay for management and advisory services provided to Knightsbridge by a Bermuda unit of ICB Shipping.
ICB International Ltd, a Liberian unit of ICB Shipping, is expected to buy 1.0 million of the shares to be offered.
The offering will be made through Goldman, Sachs & Co and Lazard Freres & Co LLC. The underwriters have an over-allotment option for up to 2.25 million additional shares.
Knightsbridge said it has applied to have its common shares quoted on the Nasdaq under the symbol "VLCC.O."
